page.layout: One column of running text, with Greek words in parentheses and a few black-letter German words. No marginal notes. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.l: subditos opprime. Bist nicht ein wütrich/oder der ein wütender
polderer (φαυλασιοχοπτῶν)[?] in vnd gegen deinem haußgesind, id est, ne familiae
offeras speciem terroris, inquirendo omnia
terribiliter, & saeuiendo in ipsos. Vnde etiam Ecclef ;3.[?] ἐ ἵστι σεὶ
οἰκέτης, ὡς αὐτὸν ὡς τέκνον[?]. Et Agapetus cap.23. Talem te praefta tuos er-
ga famulos, qualem optas erga te Dominum
esse. Item Paulus Colof.4. Viri diligite vxo-
res, & ne fitis amarulenti aduersus illas. Et
Petrus 1. Pet. 3. Viri similiter cohabitent se-
cundum scientiam, velut infirmiori vasi mu-
liebri impartientes honorem, &c.
Non solum autem leonum similes esse nō
debemus, quo ad crudelitatem & saeuitiam,
verum etiam quo ad cupiditatem & auariti-
am, seu rapacitatem, quae leonibus quoque
in Scripturis attribuitur: Naum 2.Psal.104.
Dicit enim Sapiens: Ne manum habeto ad
accipiendum porrectam, ad reddendum con-
tractam: qualem habere solent auari & sor-
didi heri, qui suae familiae multum quidem
laboris & oneris imponunt, parum vero mer-
cedis & cibi apponunt: sponte accipiunt, &
grauatim largiuntur. Ne igitur rapiamus a-
liena, sed potius largiamur nostra. Beatius
enim est dare, quam accipere: Actor.20.
Praeterea leonum est rugire, & vorare, A-
mos 3. Psal. 22. Ezech. 19. 1. Pet. 5. Instar leo-
num rugiunt, qui vociferantur, clamant, ma-
ledicunt, blasphemant, murmurant. Recte
igitur Paulus 1.Tim.3. vxores sint [illegible, ~8 letters]

page.notes: Greek in parentheses after "polderer" is uncertain (marked [?]). The Greek after "Ecclef ;3." is uncertain, and the reference "Ecclef ;3." may be misprinted. The Greek at the end of the last line is too faint to read and is marked illegible. Long s is printed as f in several words (fordidi, fuae, fponte), and it is transcribed as s. Black-letter words are marked with bl. The page number "201" is set at top right.
